content_sections.heading: IIBF Assistant Director (Academics/Training) Recruitment 2026 - Important Dates
How to Apply
content_sections.text: Applications must be submitted online on or before 21-09-2026. To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section. Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of IIBF to complete the application. Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details. Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format. Pay the application fee online, if applicable. Review all details carefully before submitting the form. Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the IIBF Assistant Director (Academics/Training) recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your online application for the IIBF Assistant Director (Academics/Training) post is 21 September 2026. Ensure you apply well before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What is the maximum age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Assistant Director (Academics/Training) post is 35 years, as of 01 September 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What are the educational qualifications required for the Assistant Director post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Post Graduate degree in Commerce/Economics/Banking/ Finance, or be a CA/CMA/CS, or have completed a 2-year MBA/PGDBA/PGDBM (Banking & Finance), Ph.D. in a related topic, CAIIB, or CFA.

faq.question: Q4. Is there any application fee for this IIBF recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the Assistant Director position?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a salary in the pay scale of Rs. 85100 - 156500 Per Month.

faq.question: Q6. How many vacancies are available for the Assistant Director post?
faq.answer: There is only one vacancy available for the Assistant Director (Academics/Training) position in this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the IIBF Assistant Director recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Assistant Director (Academics/Training) post will primarily involve a Personal Interview.

faq.question: Q8. What is the mode of application for this IIBF job?
faq.answer: Applications for the IIBF Assistant Director (Academics/Training) recruitment must be submitted online.

faq.question: Q9. In which city and state is the IIBF located for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The Indian Institute of Banking and Finance (IIBF) is located in Mumbai, Maharashtra, with a pincode of 400070.

faq.question: Q10. What type of job is this IIBF recruitment offering?
faq.answer: This recruitment is for a Full Time job position as an Assistant Director (Academics/Training).
